name: 记忆中心
description: 接入本地 pi 记忆中心（memory-server，默认 127.0.0.1:8970）：跨会话语义检索、注入上下文、写入与删除记忆。
author: PI-Desktop User

agentTools.name: Memory
agentTools.description: Call the local pi memory center (memory-server on 127.0.0.1:8970) to recall or store cross-session memories. Call ToolSearch for "memory" or "记忆" to load this tool.

action.description: search = semantic search; recall = retrieval tailored for prompt injection; remember = add one memory; extract = pull memories out of a conversation; list = browse recent memories; forget = delete by id; status = server health and stats.

category.description: Memory category, used by remember and as a filter for list.

source.description: Restrict search to the personal memory store or the imported knowledge base.

project.description: Project tag recorded with extracted memories.

session_id.description: Session tag recorded with extracted memories.

limit.description: Max rows for action=list (default 20, server cap 500).
